# College Company

> The premier operating holding company consolidating collegiate digital sports, media rights, varsity leagues, and student-athlete NIL infrastructure across 400+ North American universities.

College Company operates as an integrated corporate holding entity acquiring, scaling, and institutionalizing category-defining intellectual properties across four core operating divisions:
- Competitive Leagues & Global Events (CEX, CRL, CDRL, College Esports Champions)
- NIL & Creator Capital (College Esports NIL, High School NIL, College NIL Hub)
- Media, Broadcast & Publishing Networks (College Esports TV, College Esports Media, FAST linear network)
- Campus AI & Tournament Infrastructure (AI Compliance Copilot, Title IX Parity Engine, Campus Facility Labs)

## Key Facts & Moats
- **Portfolio Scale**: 43 generic category-defining digital domains and intellectual properties.
- **Campus Reach**: 400+ participating universities across Power-4 (SEC, Big Ten, ACC, Big 12) and mid-major conferences.
- **Media Syndication**: Over 48 million aggregate connected-TV viewing minutes across linear FAST distribution channels commanding blended $18.00–$24.00 CPMs.
- **Regulatory Moat**: Turnkey fiduciary clearinghouse automated for House v. NCAA $20M–$22.5M revenue sharing, Title IX equal opportunity auditing, and 50-state statutory compliance.

## Core Holding Divisions
- [Competitive Leagues](https://college.company/divisions/competitive-leagues): Collegiate sim racing (CRL), drone racing (CDRL), and varsity esports circuits (CEX).
- [NIL & Creator Capital](https://college.company/divisions/nil-creator-capital): Standardized institutional clearinghouse, algorithmic escrow, and student-athlete monetization.
- [Media & Broadcast](https://college.company/divisions/media-broadcast): 24/7 linear FAST streaming television network (College Esports TV).
- [Campus Infrastructure](https://college.company/divisions/campus-infrastructure): AI compliance copilot, Title IX parity auditing, and high-performance varsity gaming facilities.

## Institutional Intelligence & News
- [Market Intelligence Wire](https://college.company/intelligence/market-wire): Verified real-world reporting and analysis on House v. NCAA antitrust settlement, Title IX directives, and conference media deals.
- [Executive Thought Leadership](https://college.company/intelligence): Strategic essays on conference realignment, NIL clearinghouse architecture, and collegiate facility ROI.
- [RSS Feed](https://college.company/rss.xml): Syndicated RSS 2.0 / Atom feed for news readers and enterprise intelligence aggregators.
